expand_to_layout_marks: expand a tree so that any part with a marker in the given set is visible
expand_for_balanced_layout: update a tree's weak expand states to achieve a balanced layout with target width and max height
expand_to_depth: expand a tree up to a given depth with all foldables collapsed beyond that depth
test_expand_to_layout_marks: test expand_to_layout_marks expands foldable nodes containing specified layout marks
test_expand_for_balanced_layout: test expand_for_balanced_layout respects max_height and target_width constraints
